3062def test_cert_engine_delegation_and_cache_rules(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
3063 from types import SimpleNamespace
3064 cache_file = str(tmp_path / "cert_cache.json")
3065 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
3066 dist_m4ri.enable_distance_cache()
3067 try:
3068 # 1. Exact verified unconditional certificate writes exact distance to cache
3069 fake_exact = SimpleNamespace(
3070 status="exact", distance=5, lower_bound=5, upper_bound=5,
3071 witness_verified=True, lb_conditional=False, method="cc"
3072 )
3073 fake_pipeline = SimpleNamespace(
3074 certify=lambda *a, **kw: fake_exact,
3075 certify_dem=lambda *a, **kw: fake_exact,
3076 certify_circuit=lambda *a, **kw: fake_exact,
3077 )
3078 fake_io = SimpleNamespace(
3079 DistanceProblem=lambda *a, **kw: SimpleNamespace(args=a, **kw),
3080 read_mtx=lambda p: None,
3081 binary_csr=lambda m: m,
3082 )
3083 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri, "_get_qec_cert", lambda: (None, fake_io, fake_pipeline))
3084 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri, "_has_qec_cert", lambda: True)
3085 d, info = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(
3086 S5_H, L=S5_L, engine="cert", return_info=True, cache_file=cache_file
3087 )
3088 assert d == 5 and info == [5, 5, 0]
3089 cached = dist_m4ri.get_cached_distance(H=S5_H, L=S5_L, cache_file=cache_file)
3090 assert cached["dmin"] == 5 and cached["dmax"] == 5
3091
3092 # 2. Unverified upper bound (witness_verified=False) or conditional LB (lb_conditional=True) is NOT cached
3093 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache(cache_file, clear_file=True)
3094 fake_unverified = SimpleNamespace(
3095 status="exact", distance=5, lower_bound=5, upper_bound=5,
3096 witness_verified=False, lb_conditional=True, method="start_list"
3097 )
3098 fake_pipeline.certify = lambda *a, **kw: fake_unverified
3099 d2, info2 = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(
3100 S5_H, L=S5_L, engine="cert", return_info=True, cache_file=cache_file
3101 )
3102 assert d2 == 0 and info2 == [0, 0, 0]
3103 assert dist_m4ri.get_cached_distance(H=S5_H, L=S5_L, cache_file=cache_file) is None
3104
3105 # 2b. Unverified caller dmin > 1 must NEVER pollute _distance_cache when cert returns a smaller c_lb
3106 fake_partial = SimpleNamespace(
3107 status="timeout", distance=None, lower_bound=2, upper_bound=5,
3108 witness_verified=True, lb_conditional=False, method="cc"
3109 )
3110 fake_pipeline.certify = lambda *a, **kw: fake_partial
3111 d2b, info2b = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(
3112 S5_H, L=S5_L, dmin=4, engine="cert", return_info=True, cache_file=cache_file
3113 )
3114 assert d2b == 5 and info2b == [4, 5, 0]
3115 cached_2b = dist_m4ri.get_cached_distance(H=S5_H, L=S5_L, cache_file=cache_file)
3116 assert cached_2b["dmin"] == 2 and cached_2b["dmax"] == 5
3117
3118 # 2c. D1-OBS-1 regression: when cache already holds a certified dmin (p_dmin=3 from wmax=2),
3119 # a subsequent wmax=5 run passes wmin=3 to qec_cert, which marks lb_conditional=True with
3120 # lb_assumed_wmin=3. Because lb_assumed_wmin <= p_dmin and no trust flags or other conditional
3121 # stages exist, the new lower bound (5) is discharged and cached as exact [5, 5, 0].
3122 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache(cache_file, clear_file=True)
3123 fake_step1 = SimpleNamespace(
3124 status="bounds", distance=None, lower_bound=3, upper_bound=5,
3125 witness_verified=True, lb_conditional=False, method="cc"
3126 )
3127 fake_pipeline.certify = lambda *a, **kw: fake_step1
3128 d_s1, info_s1 = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(
3129 S5_H, L=S5_L, wmax=2, engine="cert", return_info=True, cache_file=cache_file
3130 )
3131 assert d_s1 == 5 and info_s1 == [3, 5, 0]
3132 cached_s1 = dist_m4ri.get_cached_distance(H=S5_H, L=S5_L, cache_file=cache_file)
3133 assert cached_s1["dmin"] == 3 and cached_s1["dmax"] == 5
3134
3135 # If a certificate with p_dmin=3 also has trust_sym=True (or unverified symmetry), keep rejecting LB
3136 fake_trusted_sym = SimpleNamespace(
3137 status="bounds", distance=None, lower_bound=5, upper_bound=5,
3138 witness_verified=True, lb_conditional=True, lb_assumed_wmin=3,
3139 instance={"lb_conditional": True, "lb_assumed_wmin": 3, "trust_sym": True},
3140 stages=[{"name": "search", "lb_conditional": True, "sym_kind": "orbit", "sym_verified": False}],
3141 reductions=[],
3142 )
3143 fake_pipeline.certify = lambda *a, **kw: fake_trusted_sym
3144 d_ts, info_ts = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(
3145 S5_H, L=S5_L, wmax=5, engine="cert", return_info=True, cache_file=cache_file
3146 )
3147 assert d_ts == 5 and info_ts == [3, 5, 0]
3148 assert dist_m4ri.get_cached_distance(H=S5_H, L=S5_L, cache_file=cache_file)["dmin"] == 3
3149
3150 # When the ONLY conditional reason is lb_assumed_wmin=3 <= p_dmin=3, accept LB=5 -> exact [5, 5, 0]
3151 seen_wmin = []
3152
3153 def _fake_step2(*a, **kw):
3154 w_in = int(kw.get("wmin", 1))
3155 seen_wmin.append(w_in)
3156 return SimpleNamespace(
3157 status="bounds", distance=None, lower_bound=5, upper_bound=5,
3158 witness_verified=True, lb_conditional=True, lb_assumed_wmin=w_in,
3159 instance={"lb_conditional": True, "lb_assumed_wmin": w_in},
3160 stages=[{"name": "search", "lb_conditional": True, "sym_kind": "orbit", "sym_verified": 2}],
3161 reductions=[{
3162 "name": "cc_mitm_search",
3163 "params": {
3164 "wmin": w_in, "wmax": 4, "sym_kind": "orbit",
3165 "sym_verified": 2, "lb_conditional": True,
3166 },
3167 }],
3168 )
3169
3170 fake_pipeline.certify = _fake_step2
3171 d_s2, info_s2 = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(
3172 S5_H, L=S5_L, wmax=5, engine="cert", return_info=True, cache_file=cache_file
3173 )
3174 assert seen_wmin == [3]
3175 assert d_s2 == 5 and info_s2 == [5, 5, 0]
3176 cached_s2 = dist_m4ri.get_cached_distance(H=S5_H, L=S5_L, cache_file=cache_file)
3177 assert cached_s2["dmin"] == 5 and cached_s2["dmax"] == 5
3178
3179 # 3. engine='auto' runs Stage A -> Stage B on an open-bracket distance-only call, and uses dist_m4ri alone
3180 # when do_cws=True (PY-T05)
3181 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache(cache_file, clear_file=True)

3206def test_zero_rank_g_and_css_sectors():
3207 # Hamming [7, 4, 3] parity-check matrix (rank 3, ker(H) has classical distance 3)
3208 H = np.array([
3209 [1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1],
3210 [0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1],
3211 [0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1],
3212 ], dtype=np.uint8)
3213 G_zero = np.zeros((2, 7), dtype=np.uint8)
3214
3215 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
3216 dist_m4ri.disable_distance_cache()
3217 try:
3218 d_cl, info_cl, cws_cl = dist_m4ri.compute_classical_distance(
3219 H, method=2, wmax=3, threads=2, do_cws=True, return_info=True
3220 )
3221 for m in (1, 2, 3):
3222 dq, info_q = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(
3223 H, G=G_zero, method=m, num_steps=200, wmax=3, threads=2, return_info=True
3224 )
3225 assert dq == d_cl == 3
3226 assert info_q[1] == info_cl[1] == 3
3227 dq2, info_q2, cws_q2 = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(
3228 H, G=G_zero, method=2, wmax=3, threads=2, do_cws=True, return_info=True
3229 )
3230 assert dq2 == d_cl and info_q2 == info_cl and sorted(cws_q2) == sorted(cws_cl)
3231
3232 # CSS with all-zero Hz: Z-sector (ker(Hx) \ rowspan(Hz)) equals classical distance of Hx; X-sector has d=1
3233 d_css1, dx1, dz1 = dist_m4ri.compute_css_distance(H, G_zero, method=2, wmax=3, threads=2)
3234 assert dz1 == info_cl == [3, 3, 0]
3235 assert dx1[1] == 1 and d_css1 == 1
3236
3237 # CSS with all-zero Hx: X-sector (ker(Hz) \ rowspan(Hx)) equals classical distance of Hz; Z-sector has d=1
3238 d_css2, dx2, dz2 = dist_m4ri.compute_css_distance(G_zero, H, method=2, wmax=3, threads=2)
3239 assert dx2 == info_cl == [3, 3, 0]
3240 assert dz2[1] == 1 and d_css2 == 1
3241 finally:
3242 dist_m4ri.enable_distance_cache()

3246# Version 0.17.0 (M4): the expert option rw_opt, the diagnostics of the RW pipeline of the binary, and engine='auto'
3247# as the two-stage portfolio dist_m4ri -> qec_cert. The binary and qec_cert are replaced by fakes where the test is
3248# about the Python logic (the command lines, the stages, the bounds passed on, and the cache rules).

3255class _FakeBinary:
3256 """
3257 A stand-in for subprocess.Popen of the dist_m4ri binary: records the command lines, and answers the k-th run with
3258 the k-th of the given stdout lines 'dmin dmax rw_steps' (the last one repeated) and the stderr text. The other
3259 commands (e.g., those of qec_cert) run as usual.
3260 """
3261
3262 def __init__(self, outputs, stderr=""):
3263 self.outputs = list(outputs)
3264 self.stderr = stderr
3265 self.cmds = []
3266
3267 def popen(self, cmd, *args, **kwargs):
3268 if not os.path.basename(str(cmd[0])).startswith("dist_m4ri") or "--version" in cmd:
3269 return _REAL_POPEN(cmd, *args, **kwargs)
3270 out = self.outputs[min(len(self.cmds), len(self.outputs) - 1)]
3271 self.cmds.append(list(cmd))
3272 err = self.stderr
3273
3274 class _Proc:
3275 returncode = 0
3276
3277 def __enter__(self):
3278 return self
3279
3280 def __exit__(self, *exc):
3281 return False
3282
3283 def communicate(self, timeout=None):
3284 return out + "\n", err
3285
3286 def terminate(self):
3287 pass
3288
3289 def kill(self):
3290 pass
3291
3292 def wait(self):
3293 return 0
3294
3295 return _Proc()
3296
3297 def arg(self, k, name):
3298 """The value of name=... on the k-th command line (None if absent)."""
3299 vals = [t.split("=", 1)[1] for t in self.cmds[k] if t.startswith(name + "=")]
3300 return vals[-1] if vals else None
3301

3303def _fake_qec_cert(monkeypatch, certify=None, certify_dem=None, certify_circuit=None):
3304 """Installs a fake qec_cert (found, importable); returns the list of its calls (kind, kwargs)."""
3305 from types import SimpleNamespace
3306 calls = []
3307
3308 def rec(kind, fn):
3309 def f(*a, **kw):
3310 calls.append((kind, kw))
3311 if fn is None:
3312 raise AssertionError(f"unexpected qec_cert call {kind}")
3313 return fn(*a, **kw)
3314 return f
3315
3316 pipeline = SimpleNamespace(certify=rec("certify", certify), certify_dem=rec("certify_dem", certify_dem),
3317 certify_circuit=rec("certify_circuit", certify_circuit))
3318 qec_io = SimpleNamespace(DistanceProblem=lambda *a, **kw: SimpleNamespace(args=a, **kw),
3319 read_mtx=lambda p: None, binary_csr=lambda m: m)
3320 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri, "_get_qec_cert", lambda: (None, qec_io, pipeline))
3321 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri, "_qec_cert_available", lambda: True)
3322 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri, "_has_qec_cert", lambda: True)
3323 return calls

3335class _FakeCert:
3336 """Stand-in for qec_cert.pipeline.Certificate computing lb_conditional (incl. lb_trail) as qec_cert does."""
3337
3338 def __init__(self, *, status="bounds", lower_bound=1, upper_bound=None, witness=None, witness_verified=None,
3339 method="cc", instance=None, stages=None, reductions=None, lb_trail=None,
3340 precondition_violated=False, **extra):
3341 self.status = status
3342 self.lower_bound = lower_bound
3343 self.upper_bound = upper_bound
3344 self.witness = witness
3345 self.witness_verified = witness_verified
3346 self.method = method
3347 self.instance = instance if instance is not None else {}
3348 self.stages = list(stages or [])
3349 self.reductions = list(reductions or [])
3350 self.lb_trail = list(lb_trail or [])
3351 self.precondition_violated = precondition_violated
3352 self._extra_lb_cond = extra.pop("lb_conditional", None)
3353 self._extra_assumed_wmin = extra.pop("lb_assumed_wmin", None)
3354 for k, v in extra.items():
3355 setattr(self, k, v)
3356
3357 @property
3358 def lb_conditional(self):
3359 if self._extra_lb_cond is not None:
3360 return bool(self._extra_lb_cond)
3361 return bool(
3362 self.status == "conditional"
3363 or (isinstance(self.instance, dict) and self.instance.get("lb_conditional"))
3364 or any(s.get("lb_conditional") for s in self.stages if isinstance(s, dict))
3365 or any((r.get("params") or {}).get("lb_conditional") for r in self.reductions if isinstance(r, dict))
3366 or any(e.get("conditional") for e in self.lb_trail if isinstance(e, dict))
3367 )
3368
3369 @property
3370 def lb_assumed_wmin(self):
3371 if self._extra_assumed_wmin is not None:
3372 return int(self._extra_assumed_wmin)
3373 if isinstance(self.instance, dict) and self.instance.get("lb_assumed_wmin") is not None:
3374 return int(self.instance["lb_assumed_wmin"])
3375 return None
3376
3377
3378def _cert_search_lb(lb=None, extra_instance=None, **extra):
3379 """
3380 A fake qec_cert certify*() which, like qec_cert, proves that there is no codeword of weight wmin..wmax (lower
3381 bound wmax + 1, or lb), without a witness, conditional on its assumption lb_assumed_wmin = wmin if wmin > 1
3382 (recorded in instance and lb_trail, PY-T20). Keyword arguments override fields of the certificate.
3383 """
3384 def fn(*a, **kw):
3385 w_lo, w_hi = int(kw["wmin"]), int(kw["wmax"])
3386 lb_val = lb if lb is not None else w_hi + 1
3387 inst = {"lb_conditional": w_lo > 1, **({"lb_assumed_wmin": w_lo} if w_lo > 1 else {}), **(extra_instance or {})}
3388 trail = ([{"stage": "user_wmin", "lb": w_lo, "conditional": True},
3389 {"stage": "search", "lb": lb_val, "conditional": True}]
3390 if w_lo > 1 else [{"stage": "search", "lb": lb_val, "conditional": False}])
3391 fields = dict(status="bounds", lower_bound=lb_val, upper_bound=None, witness=None, witness_verified=None,
3392 instance=inst, stages=[], reductions=[], lb_trail=trail)
3393 fields.update({k: (v(w_lo, w_hi) if callable(v) else v) for k, v in extra.items()})
3394 return _FakeCert(**fields)
3395 return fn
3396
3397
3398_NOSYM_RULES = ["up0", "up1", "pack_cov", "parity_dual", "cayley", "lfup", "table", "dual_fixing"]
3399
3400
3401def _search_stage(w_lo, w_hi, rules=tuple(_NOSYM_RULES), sym_kind="unknown", sym_verified=0):
3402 """The search stage and its cc_mitm_search reduction of qec_cert (by default, as without symmetry) for wmin > 1."""
3403 flags = {"sym_kind": sym_kind, "sym_verified": sym_verified, "lb_conditional": True,
3404 **({"rules": list(rules)} if rules is not None else {})}
3405 return ([{"name": "prep", "status": "ok"}, {"name": "search", "status": "none", "lb": w_hi + 1, **flags}],
3406 [{"name": "cc_mitm_search", "params": {"wmin": w_lo, "wmax": w_hi, **flags}}])

3409def _no_native_tail(run, res, info, **kw):
3410 """A stand-in for _auto_native_tail(): no third stage (the stages recorded, the result unchanged)."""
3411 dist_m4ri._last_run_stats["engine_auto"] = info
3412 return res

3415def _cert_exact(d):
3416 """A fake qec_cert certify*() with the exact distance d (a verified witness, unconditional)."""
3417 return lambda *a, **kw: _FakeCert(status="exact", lower_bound=d, upper_bound=d, witness_verified=True,
3418 instance={}, stages=[], reductions=[],
3419 lb_trail=[{"stage": "search", "lb": d, "conditional": False}])

3422def test_rw_opt_passthrough(monkeypatch, capsys, tmp_path):
3423 # rw_opt is passed to the binary as rw_opt=N (None, the default: not passed); -1, 0, and 1..63 are valid
3424 fake = _FakeBinary(["3 3 0"])

3426 h_file = os.path.join(EXAMPLES_DIR, "c96H.mmx")

3428 dist_m4ri.run_dist_m4ri(method=1, finH=h_file, classical=1, steps=1, threads=1, rw_opt=val)
3429 assert fake.arg(len(fake.cmds) - 1, "rw_opt") == tok, val
3430 for bad in (-2, 64, True, 1.5, "3"):
3431 with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="rw_opt"):
3432 dist_m4ri.run_dist_m4ri(method=1, finH=h_file, classical=1, steps=1, rw_opt=bad)

3435 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
3436 dist_m4ri.disable_distance_cache()
3437 try:
3438 fake.cmds.clear()
3439 dist_m4ri.compute_classical_distance(HAMMING_H, threads=1, rw_opt=5)
3440 dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, threads=1, rw_opt=0)
3441 dist_m4ri.compute_css_distance(S5_H, S5_H, Lx=S5_L, Lz=S5_L, threads=1, rw_opt=16)
3442 dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(SURF_D3_DEM, threads=1, rw_opt=1)
3443 dist_m4ri.compute_model_lower_bound(SURF_D3_DEM, threads=1, rw_opt=2)

3445 fake.cmds.clear()
3446 dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, threads=1) # (the default: not passed)
3447 assert fake.arg(0, "rw_opt") is None
3448 # the CLI: rw_opt=N, --rw-opt N (also -1), hexadecimal, and the aliases rw-opt / rwopt
3449 for argv, val in ((["rw_opt=0x11"], 17), (["--rw-opt", "-1"], -1), (["--rw-opt=5"], 5), (["rw-opt=0"], 0),
3450 (["--rwopt", "0X3f"], 63), ([], None)):
3451 assert dist_m4ri.parse_cli_args(argv)["rw_opt"] == val, argv
3452 for argv in (["rw_opt=64"], ["rw_opt=-2"], ["rw_opt=abc"], ["--rw-opt"], ["--rw-opt", "x"]):
3453 with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="rw_opt|rw-opt"):

3455 assert dist_m4ri.main([f"finH={h_file}", "rw_opt=64", "--no-cache"]) == 1
3456 assert "invalid 'rw_opt=64'" in capsys.readouterr().err
3457 fake.cmds.clear()
3458 assert dist_m4ri.main([f"finH={h_file}", "--rw-opt", "3", "--no-cache", "threads=1"]) == 0
3459 assert fake.arg(0, "rw_opt") == "3" and "3 3 0 (exact)" in capsys.readouterr().out
3460 finally:
3461 dist_m4ri.enable_distance_cache()
3462 # the help: an entry of --morehelp (also --help rw-opt), and the short list of the parameters (PY-T08: no stderr)
3463 fake.cmds.clear()
3464 assert dist_m4ri.main(["--help", "rw-opt"]) == 0
3465 out, err = capsys.readouterr()

3469 assert "rw_opt" in capsys.readouterr().out

3654@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_cache", [True, False])
3655def test_auto_stage_b_seeding_and_discharge(monkeypatch, tmp_path, use_cache):
3656 # Stage A ends with the open bracket [3, 5] (a fake binary): Stage B runs qec_cert with wmin=3, wmax=4 and the
3657 # remaining time; its lower bound 5, conditional only on lb_assumed_wmin=3, is discharged by the dmin=3 certified
3658 # by Stage A, with or without the cache (the bounds are passed explicitly)
3659 cache_file = str(tmp_path / "auto_b.json") if use_cache else None
3660 fake = _FakeBinary(["3 5 100"])
3661 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri.subprocess, "Popen", fake.popen)
3662 calls = _fake_qec_cert(monkeypatch, certify=_cert_search_lb())
3663 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
3664 if not use_cache:
3665 dist_m4ri.disable_distance_cache()
3666 try:
3667 d, info = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, engine="auto", timeout=20, threads=2,
3668 return_info=True, cache_file=cache_file)
3669 assert (d, info) == (5, [5, 5, 0])
3670 assert len(fake.cmds) == 1 and fake.arg(0, "timeout") == "2.0" and fake.arg(0, "method") == "3"
3671 assert len(calls) == 1 and calls[0][1]["wmin"] == 3 and calls[0][1]["wmax"] == 4
3672 assert 18.5 < calls[0][1]["time_limit"] <= 20.0 and calls[0][1]["mode"] == "auto"
3673 assert calls[0][1]["use_ub"] is False # (narrow bracket [3, 5]: no ISD in qec_cert)
3674 auto = dist_m4ri._last_run_stats["engine_auto"]
3675 assert auto["stage"] == "B" and auto["stage_a"] == [3, 5, 100] and auto["stage_b"] == [5, 5]
3676 cached = dist_m4ri.get_cached_distance(H=S5_H, L=S5_L, cache_file=cache_file)
3677 if use_cache:
3678 assert (cached["dmin"], cached["dmax"], cached["rw_steps"]) == (5, 5, 100)
3679 else:
3680 assert cached is None
3681 # a wide bracket [3, 6] (gap 3 >= 3): Stage B keeps use_ub=True so qec_cert's ISD can tighten the upper bound
3682 fake.outputs, fake.cmds[:] = ["3 6 100"], []
3683 if use_cache:
3684 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache(cache_file, clear_file=True)
3685 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
3686 calls[:] = []
3687 d, info = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, engine="auto", timeout=20, threads=2,
3688 return_info=True, cache_file=cache_file)
3689 assert calls[0][1]["wmax"] == 5 and calls[0][1]["use_ub"] is True
3690 # qec_cert proves no codeword of weight 3..5: exact 6 (the codeword of weight 6 found by Stage A)
3691 assert (d, info) == (6, [6, 6, 0])
3692 finally:
3693 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
3694 dist_m4ri.enable_distance_cache()

3732def test_cert_wmin_discharged_without_symmetry(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
3733 # qec_cert without any symmetry (e.g., none found, or more than max_sym_cols columns) marks its search with wmin > 1
3734 # conditional for the floor wmin alone (sym_kind 'unknown', sym_verified 0, no rule sym_anchors): its lower bound is
3735 # accepted if lb_assumed_wmin <= the certified dmin, with engine='auto' and with engine='cert' (D1-OBS-1)
3736 from types import SimpleNamespace
3737
3738 def cert(w_lo=5, w_hi=6, status="timeout", **kw):
3739 stages, reds = _search_stage(w_lo, w_hi, **kw)
3740 return SimpleNamespace(status=status, lower_bound=w_hi + 1, upper_bound=None, witness_verified=None,
3741 lb_conditional=True, lb_assumed_wmin=w_lo, stages=stages, reductions=reds,
3742 instance={"lb_conditional": True, "lb_assumed_wmin": w_lo})
3743 c = cert()
3744 assert dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(c, 5) and dist_m4ri._cert_extract_bounds(c, 6) == (7, 0)
3745 assert not dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(c, 4) and dist_m4ri._cert_extract_bounds(c, 4) == (0, 0)
3746 for kw in ({"rules": _NOSYM_RULES + ["sym_anchors"]}, {"rules": _NOSYM_RULES + ["trust_sym"]},
3747 {"rules": _NOSYM_RULES + ["trust_quot"]}, {"rules": _NOSYM_RULES + ["schreier"]},
3748 {"rules": _NOSYM_RULES + ["centroid"]}, {"sym_kind": "orbit"}, {"sym_kind": "pinned"},
3749 {"sym_kind": "unknown", "rules": _NOSYM_RULES + ["sym_anchors", "trust_sym"]}, {"rules": None}):
3750 assert not dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(cert(**kw), 5), kw
3751 assert dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(cert(sym_kind="orbit", sym_verified=2), 5) # (a verified symmetry)
3752 dist_m4ri.disable_distance_cache()
3753 try:
3754 assert dist_m4ri._cert_code_distance(lambda: "unused", lambda w_lo, w_hi: cert(w_lo, w_hi, status="bounds"),
3755 dmin=5, dmax=7, certified_dmin=5)["d_info"] == [7, 7, 0]
3756 # engine='auto' end to end: Stage A [5, 7], Stage B proves no codeword of weight 5..6 without symmetry
3757 fake = _FakeBinary(["5 7 40"])
3758 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri.subprocess, "Popen", fake.popen)
3759 calls = _fake_qec_cert(monkeypatch, certify=lambda *a, **kw: cert(kw["wmin"], kw["wmax"], status="bounds"))
3760 d, info = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, engine="auto", timeout=20, threads=2,
3761 return_info=True)
3762 assert (d, info) == (7, [7, 7, 0]) and (calls[0][1]["wmin"], calls[0][1]["wmax"]) == (5, 6)
3763 finally:
3764 dist_m4ri.enable_distance_cache()
3765 # engine='cert' (D1-OBS-1): the dmin=5 of the cache record discharges the floor wmin=5 of qec_cert
3766 cache_file = str(tmp_path / "nosym.json")
3767 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
3768 try:
3769 dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, threads=2, cache_file=cache_file) # (the record [5, 7])
3770 calls[:] = []
3771 d, info = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, engine="cert", return_info=True,
3772 cache_file=cache_file)
3773 assert (d, info) == (7, [7, 7, 0]) and (calls[0][1]["wmin"], calls[0][1]["wmax"]) == (5, 6)
3774 assert dist_m4ri.get_cached_distance(H=S5_H, L=S5_L, cache_file=cache_file)["dmin"] == 7
3775 finally:
3776 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()

3779def test_cert_code_distance_certified_dmin():
3780 # _cert_code_distance(): the assumption lb_assumed_wmin of qec_cert is discharged only by a certified dmin (the
3781 # cache record or certified_dmin); since 0.17.2 (PY-02), the caller's dmin is not passed to qec_cert as wmin (its
3782 # lower bound would be conditional on it): qec_cert runs from wmin = max(1, certified dmin)
3783 dist_m4ri.disable_distance_cache()
3784 try:
3785 seen = []
3786
3787 def run(dmin, certified_dmin):
3788 def cert(w_lo, w_hi):
3789 seen.append((w_lo, w_hi))
3790 return _cert_search_lb()(wmin=w_lo, wmax=w_hi)
3791 return dist_m4ri._cert_code_distance(lambda: "unused", cert, dmin=dmin, dmax=5,
3792 certified_dmin=certified_dmin)
3793 assert run(3, 0)["d_info"] == [5, 5, 0] and seen[-1] == (1, 4) # (unconditional: no floor)
3794 assert run(3, 3)["d_info"] == [5, 5, 0] and seen[-1] == (3, 4)
3795 assert run(3, 4)["d_info"] == [5, 5, 0] and seen[-1] == (4, 4)
3796 assert run(4, 3)["d_info"] == [5, 5, 0] and seen[-1] == (3, 4) # (the floor is the certified 3, not 4)
3797 assert run(0, 0)["d_info"] == [5, 5, 0] and seen[-1] == (1, 4)
3798 # a caller's dmin above the weight of a verified witness is not valid: the certified bounds are returned
3799 res = dist_m4ri._cert_code_distance(lambda: "unused", lambda w_lo, w_hi: _cert_exact(3)(), dmin=4, dmax=0)
3800 assert res["d_info"] == [3, 3, 0]
3801 finally:
3802 dist_m4ri.enable_distance_cache()
3803

3843
3844 def boom(*a, **kw):

3846

3850 try:

3859 # qec_cert raises the lower bound to 4 only (and returns early): the binary from [4, 6]

3986def _probe_state(monkeypatch, **values):
3987 """Resets the memoized qec_cert probe of dist_m4ri (restored at the end of the test), with the values given."""
3988 state = {"_qec_cert_mod": None, "_qec_cert_status": None, "_qec_cert_missing": False, "_qec_cert_warned": False}
3989 state.update(values)
3990 for name, val in state.items():
3991 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri, name, val)

3994@pytest.fixture
3995def fake_qec_cert_package(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
3996 """
3997 A function which installs a package qec_cert in tmp_path, found first on sys.path, whose library cannot be loaded
3998 (its _lib.load() raises LibraryNotFound, an OSError, as qec_cert without libqeccert.so); the modules qec_cert* and
3999 the probe state of dist_m4ri are restored at the end of the test.
4000 """
4001 import importlib
4002 saved = {m: sys.modules[m] for m in list(sys.modules) if m == "qec_cert" or m.startswith("qec_cert.")}
4003 for m in saved:
4004 del sys.modules[m]
4005
4006 def install():
4007 pkg = tmp_path / "fake_site" / "qec_cert"
4008 pkg.mkdir(parents=True)
4009 (pkg / "__init__.py").write_text("")
4010 (pkg / "io.py").write_text("")
4011 (pkg / "pipeline.py").write_text("def certify(*a, **kw):\n raise AssertionError('certify called')\n")
4012 (pkg / "_lib.py").write_text(
4013 "class LibraryNotFound(OSError):\n pass\n\n\ndef load():\n"
4014 " raise LibraryNotFound('libqeccert.so not found (run `make` or set QEC_CERT_LIB): x: not found')\n")
4015 monkeypatch.syspath_prepend(str(pkg.parent))
4016 monkeypatch.delenv("QEC_CERT_LIB", raising=False)
4017 importlib.invalidate_caches()
4018 _probe_state(monkeypatch)
4019 yield install
4020 for m in [m for m in list(sys.modules) if m == "qec_cert" or m.startswith("qec_cert.")]:
4021 del sys.modules[m]
4022 sys.modules.update(saved)

4025def test_cert_pmin_certifies_the_cut_dem(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
4026 # PY-01: engine='cert' with pmin > 0 certifies the model of the cache key, the DEM without the errors of
4027 # probability < pmin (as the binary reads it with pmin=), also for a Stim circuit (certify_dem() of the cut DEM)
4028 stim = pytest.importorskip("stim")
4029 dem_file = tmp_path / "pmin_cut.dem"
4030 dem_file.write_text(PMIN_CUT_DEM)
4031 seen = []
4032
4033 def certify_dem(dem, **kw): # (the distance of the DEM given: 1 with the error L0, 2 without it)
4034 d_obj = dem if isinstance(dem, stim.DetectorErrorModel) else stim.DetectorErrorModel.from_file(str(dem))
4035 seen.append(d_obj)
4036 return _cert_exact(1 if any(i.type == "error" and i.args_copy()[0] < 0.001 for i in d_obj.flattened())
4037 else 2)()
4038 calls = _fake_qec_cert(monkeypatch, certify_dem=certify_dem)
4039 cache_file = str(tmp_path / "pmin_cache.json")
4040 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
4041 try:
4042 assert dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(str(dem_file), pmin=0.001, threads=1, cache_file=None) == (2, [2, 2, 0])
4043 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
4044 d, info = dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(str(dem_file), engine="cert", pmin=0.001, cache_file=cache_file)
4045 assert (d, info) == (2, [2, 2, 0]) and seen[-1].num_errors == 4
4046 rec = dist_m4ri.get_cached_distance(dem=str(dem_file), pmin=0.001, cache_file=cache_file)
4047 assert (rec["dmin"], rec["dmax"]) == (2, 2)
4048 # without a cutoff, the full DEM (the file as given)
4049 d, info = dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(str(dem_file), engine="cert", cache_file=cache_file)
4050 assert d == 1 and seen[-1].num_errors == 5
4051 assert [c[0] for c in calls] == ["certify_dem", "certify_dem"]
4052 # a Stim circuit with pmin > 0: certify_dem() of its DEM without the errors < pmin, not certify_circuit()
4053 circ = stim.Circuit.generated("repetition_code:memory", rounds=2, distance=3,
4054 after_clifford_depolarization=0.01, before_measure_flip_probability=0.01)
4055 calls[:] = []
4056 dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(circuit=circ, engine="cert", pmin=0.003, cache_file=cache_file)
4057 assert [c[0] for c in calls] == ["certify_dem"]
4058 probs = [i.args_copy()[0] for i in seen[-1].flattened() if i.type == "error"]
4059 assert probs and min(probs) >= 0.003 and len(probs) < circ.detector_error_model().num_errors
4060 finally:
4061 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()

4418def test_auto_native_tail_time_left(monkeypatch):

4479def test_cli_values_and_flags(monkeypatch, capsys):
4480 # PY-C02: non-numeric values name the option; the disabled options are ignored with a warning (not an error);
4481 # PY-C03: '--key VALUE' takes a negative number; PY-C04: cws=off, do_cws=0; PY-C11: 'finH= FILE' (as the binary);
4482 # PY-C14: the flags also as key=value; numbers as the binary reads them (steps=1e5, steps=1.5 -> 1 with warning,
4483 # threads=4x -> 4 with warning, NaN/inf rejected, timeout=10s and timeout=inf accepted)
4484 c96 = os.path.join(EXAMPLES_DIR, "c96H.mmx")
4485 parse = dist_m4ri.parse_cli_args
4486 for argv, msg in ((["dmin=abc"], "invalid 'dmin=abc': expected an integer"),
4487 (["steps="], "invalid 'steps=': expected an integer"),
4488 (["steps=.5"], "invalid 'steps=.5': expected an integer"),
4489 (["steps=nan"], "invalid 'steps=nan': expected an integer"),
4490 (["steps=inf"], "invalid 'steps=inf': expected an integer"),
4491 (["steps=-inf"], "invalid 'steps=-inf': expected an integer"),
4492 (["steps=1e12"], "invalid 'steps=1e12': the value is out of range"),
4493 (["timeout=x"], "invalid 'timeout=x': expected a number"),
4494 (["--dstop", "-1"], "invalid 'dstop=-1': dstop must be non-negative"),
4495 (["finH="], "'finH=': missing file name")):
4496 with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=re.escape(msg)):
4497 parse(argv)
4498 a = parse(["irred=abc", "noscan=abc", "cbeg=abc", "css=x"])
4499 assert (a["irred"], a["noscan"], a["cbeg"], a["css"]) == ("abc", "abc", "abc", "x")
4500 assert parse(["--kwin", "-1", "--seed", "-3"])["kwin"] == -1 and parse(["--seed", "-3"])["seed"] == -3
4501 assert parse(["cws=off"])["do_cws"] is False and parse(["do_cws=0"])["do_cws"] is False
4502 assert parse(["do_cws=1"])["do_cws"] is True and parse(["--cws"])["do_cws"] is True
4503 a = parse(["finH=", c96, "finG=", c96])
4504 assert a["finH"] == c96 and a["finG"] == c96 and a["unrecognized"] == []
4505 a = parse(["--no-throttle=1", "--silent=1", "--no-cache=1"])
4506 assert a["nothrottle"] and a["silent"] and not a["use_cache"] and a["cache_file"] is None
4507 a = parse(["--no-throttle=0", "--silent=0", "--no-cache=0"])
4508 assert not a["nothrottle"] and not a["silent"] and a["use_cache"]
4509 capsys.readouterr()
4510 a = parse(["steps=1e5", "threads=4.0", "maxC=1e12"]) # (integer float values: no warning; maxC is 64-bit)
4511 assert (a["steps"], a["threads"], a["maxC"]) == (100000, 4, 10**12) and capsys.readouterr().err == ""
4512 for argv, key, exp, warn in (
4513 (["steps=1.5"], "steps", 1, "# WARNING: 'steps=1.5' read as 1 (the rest of the value, '.5', is ignored)\n"),
4514 (["threads=4x"], "threads", 4, "# WARNING: 'threads=4x' read as 4 (the rest of the value, 'x', is ignored)\n"),
4515 (["kwin=-1.5"], "kwin", -1, "# WARNING: 'kwin=-1.5' read as -1 (the rest of the value, '.5', is ignored)\n"),
4516 (["--kwin", "-4x"], "kwin", -4, "# WARNING: 'kwin=-4x' read as -4 (the rest of the value, 'x', is ignored)\n"),

4559def test_explain_rule_that_decided_and_lower_bound_source():
4560 # PY-12: with the canonical classes of rw_opt 16, the explanation states their stopping rule (evaluated), not <n>;
4561 # the n/a values of the binary (no codeword of the minimum weight in a uniform step) and its note; PY-13: the model
4562 # check compares with the zero-truncated Poisson mean; PY-15: the source of the lower bound
4563 import math
4564 head = ("# RW information sets: n=5473, rank(H)=336, steps=4100 (uniform permutations: 4100), ksub=0, pairs=13, "
4565 "0.003 s/step per thread, 4 RW threads\n")
4566 cws = ("# codewords accumulated: total=100, min_w=7: cws=100, total_hits=158, hits min=1, max=18, avg=1.58, "
4567 "stdev=2.22, <n>=1.58 over 100 cws of w=7..7 (min_hits=5, cov_cws=100)")
4568 canon = ("# RW canonical (w=7): classes=3595, raw_cws=69295, M_eff=19.28, unif_inc=41341, f1=681, f2=428, "
4569 "p_GT=0.0165, C0_Chao2=539.7\n")
4570 for suffix in (", not used: the canonical classes decide (see '# RW canonical')", ""): # (0.17.2, 0.17.1)
4571 st = dist_m4ri._parse_stderr_stats(head + cws + suffix + "\n" + canon)
4572 assert dist_m4ri._canon_rule_decides(st) and st.get("canon_decides", False) == bool(suffix)
4573 text = dist_m4ri.explain_bounds([0, 7, 4100], method=1, stats=st)
4574 assert "decided by the canonical classes of rw_opt 16" in text
4575 assert "N/C = 11.50 >= min_hits = 5 (yes)" in text and "Chao2 C0/(C+C0) = 0.131 <= 0.05 (no)" in text
4576 assert "Hit-based estimate" not in text and "P_fail ~ exp(-<n>)" not in text
4577 st = dist_m4ri._parse_stderr_stats(head + cws + "\n") # (the rule of <n>: unchanged)
4578 assert not dist_m4ri._canon_rule_decides(st)
4579 text = dist_m4ri.explain_bounds([0, 7, 4100], method=1, stats=st)
4580 assert "P_fail ~ exp(-<n>) = 0.21" in text and "Hit-based estimate" in text and "Stopping rule" not in text
4581 na = ("# codewords accumulated: total=93, min_w=18: cws=93, total_hits=93, hits min=1, max=1, avg=1.00, "
4582 "stdev=0.00, <n>=1.00 over 93 cws of w=18..18 (min_hits=5, cov_cws=100), not used: the canonical classes "
4583 "decide (see '# RW canonical')\n# RW canonical (w=18): classes=0, raw_cws=0, M_eff=n/a, unif_inc=0, f1=0, "
4584 "f2=0, p_GT=n/a, C0_Chao2=n/a\n# Note: the min_hits stop was inactive: no codeword of the minimum weight 18 "
4585 "was found in a "
4586 "uniform RW step (the canonical classes of rw_opt 16 count only these; the window steps found 93 codewords "
4587 "of weight 18 in hash, not used to stop)\n")
4588 st = dist_m4ri._parse_stderr_stats(head + na)
4589 assert st["rw_canon"]["p_GT"] is None and st["rw_canon"]["M_eff"] is None and st["rw_canon"]["unif_inc"] == 0
4590 text = dist_m4ri.explain_bounds([16, 18, 4100], method=3, stats=st)
4591 assert "Stopping rule (canonical classes, rw_opt 16): the min_hits stop was inactive" in text
4592 assert "Canonical class coverage" not in text
4593 # PY-13: the expected average over the codewords found (each at least once) is the zero-truncated Poisson mean
4594 st = dist_m4ri._parse_stderr_stats(head + cws + "\n# RW step types, w=7: uniform steps: cws=100, hits=158; window "
4595 "steps: cws=0, hits=0; both: cws=0 (of 100 cws)\n")
4596 mu = 4100 * dist_m4ri.rw_infoset_find_prob(5473, 336, 7, 13)
4597 text = dist_m4ri.explain_bounds([0, 7, 4100], method=1, stats=st)
4598 assert f"(zero-truncated Poisson, mean {mu:.3g} hits): {mu / -math.expm1(-mu):.3g}, observed average 1.58" in text
4599 # PY-15: the lower bound and its source
4600 lb = dist_m4ri.explain_bounds
4601 assert "certified by qec_cert (engine='cert')" in lb([5, 7, 0], stats={"engine_cert": {"cached": False, "lb": 5}})
4602 assert "(a cache record; engine='cert')" in lb([5, 7, 0], stats={"engine_cert": {"cached": True}})
4603 assert "qec_cert (Stage B of engine='auto')" in lb([5, 7, 0], stats={"engine_auto": {"stage_a": [3, 7, 10],
4604 "stage_b": [5, 7]}})
4605 assert "All cluster weights w <= 4 were exhaustively analyzed by CC" in lb([5, 7, 0], stats={"hit_warnings": []})
4606 assert "All cluster weights w <= 4 were exhaustively analyzed by CC" in lb([5, 0, 0], method=2)
4607 assert "(a certified lower bound of the cache, of an earlier run, or dmin=)" in lb([5, 7, 0], stats={})
4608

4750def test_bitpacked_gf2_k0_and_medium_dem(monkeypatch, capsys, tmp_path):
4751 # Bit-packed GF(2) elimination (_pack_gf2_rows, _gf2_echelon, _gf2_rank), single-elimination _k0_of_matrices with
4752 # classical m < n shortcut, and reduced-DEM _dem_k0 on codedistance paths (#253).
4753 from types import SimpleNamespace
4754 rng = np.random.default_rng(20261117)
4755
4756 # 1. Multi-word rank across sparse (including duplicate entries mod 2), dense, float/int, and file inputs
4757 base = rng.integers(0, 2, size=(18, 210), dtype=np.uint8)
4758 comb = rng.integers(0, 2, size=(40, 18), dtype=np.uint8)
4759 dense = (comb @ base) & 1 # rank <= 18 across 4 uint64 words
4760 packed, n_cols = dist_m4ri._pack_gf2_rows(dense)
4761 assert packed.dtype == np.uint64 and packed.shape == (40, 4) and n_cols == 210
4762 ech = packed.copy()
4763 r_ech, pivs = dist_m4ri._gf2_echelon(ech)
4764 assert len(pivs) == len(set(pivs)) == r_ech <= 18
4765 assert [p >> 6 for p in pivs] == sorted(p >> 6 for p in pivs)
4766 for i, c in enumerate(pivs):
4767 assert (int(ech[i, c >> 6]) >> (c & 63)) & 1 == 1
4768 assert all(((int(ech[i, c0 >> 6]) >> (c0 & 63)) & 1) == 0 for c0 in pivs[:i])
4769 # Multi-panel within a single 64-bit word (rank ~ 20 > 2 panels of 8 bits in word 0)
4770 b1 = rng.integers(0, 2, size=(20, 64), dtype=np.uint8)
4771 h1 = (rng.integers(0, 2, size=(35, 20), dtype=np.uint8) @ b1) & 1
4772 l1 = (rng.integers(0, 2, size=(15, 35), dtype=np.uint8) @ h1) & 1
4773 assert dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(h1, L=l1)
4774 # Force pure-Python _gf2_echelon path even if qec_cert is loaded, and compare
4775 r_ref = dist_m4ri._gf2_rank(dense)
4776 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri, "_qec_cert_mod", None)
4777 assert dist_m4ri._gf2_rank(dense) == r_ech == r_ref
4778 assert dist_m4ri._gf2_rank(dense.astype(np.float64) * 3.0) == r_ech # odd floats -> 1
4779 assert dist_m4ri._gf2_rank(sp.csr_matrix(dense)) == r_ech
4780 # Duplicate sparse COO entries sum mod 2 (two 1s at (0, 0) cancel)
4781 coo_dup = sp.coo_matrix(([1, 1, 1], ([0, 0, 1], [0, 0, 130])), shape=(3, 210))
4782 assert dist_m4ri._gf2_rank(coo_dup) == 1
4783
4784 # 2. Classical m < n shortcut avoids unpacking or touching matrix entries
4785 class _NoTouchSparse:
4786 shape = (50, 130)
4787
4788 def tocoo(self, copy=False):
4789 raise AssertionError("m < n shortcut should return False without packing")
4790
4791 assert not dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(_NoTouchSparse(), classical=True)
4792 assert not dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(_NoTouchSparse(), G=_NoTouchSparse(), classical=False)
4793
4794 # Classical m >= n: k = 0 vs k > 0 across >1 uint64 word
4795 eye70 = sp.eye(70, format="csr", dtype=np.uint8)
4796 h_full = sp.vstack([eye70, eye70[:10]], format="csr")
4797 h_def = sp.csr_matrix(np.eye(70, dtype=np.uint8)[:-1]) # 69 x 70 -> m < n -> k > 0
4798 h_sing = sp.vstack([h_def, h_def[:5]], format="csr") # 74 x 70, rank 69 < 70 -> k > 0
4799 assert dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(h_full, classical=True)
4800 assert not dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(h_def, classical=True)
4801 assert not dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(h_sing, classical=True)
4802
4803 # Quantum (H, G) and (H, L): k = 0 vs k > 0
4804 assert dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(eye70[:35], G=eye70[35:])
4805 assert not dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(eye70[:34], G=eye70[35:])
4806 l_dep = (rng.integers(0, 2, size=(4, 40), dtype=np.uint8) @ dense) & 1 # in rowspace(dense) -> k = 0
4807 assert dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(sp.csr_matrix(dense), L=sp.csr_matrix(l_dep))
4808 assert dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(sp.csr_matrix(dense), L=sp.csr_matrix((2, 210), dtype=np.uint8)) # zero L -> k = 0
4809 l_indep = np.zeros((2, 210), dtype=np.uint8)
4810 non_piv = next(c for c in range(210) if c not in set(pivs))
4811 l_indep[1, non_piv] = 1 # outside rowspace(dense) -> k > 0
4812 assert not dist_m4ri._k0_of_matrices(sp.csr_matrix(dense), L=sp.csr_matrix(l_indep))
4813
4814 # 3. _dem_k0 merges equal columns and drops zero columns, including on a medium DEM
4815 dem_dup = ("error(0.1) D0 D1 L0\nerror(0.2) D0 D1 L0\nerror(0.1) D0 D1\nerror(0.1)\n"
4816 "error(0.01) D1 L0\n")
4817 assert not dist_m4ri._dem_k0(dem_dup) # D0 D1 L0 + D0 D1 gives L0 -> k > 0
4818 dep_dem = "error(0.1) D0 L0\nerror(0.2) D0 L0\nerror(0.1) D1\nerror(0.001) D1 L0\n"
4819 assert not dist_m4ri._dem_k0(dep_dem, pmin=0.0)
4820 assert dist_m4ri._dem_k0(dep_dem, pmin=0.01) # pmin drops D1 L0, leaving L0 == D0 -> k = 0

4823 if dist_m4ri._HAS_STIM:
4824 import stim
4825 med_circ = stim.Circuit.generated(
4826 "surface_code:rotated_memory_z", distance=7, rounds=7,

4830 else:
4831 med_dem_text = Path(surf_d5_dem).read_text()

4833 for use_qec in (True, False):
4834 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri, "_qec_cert_available", (lambda: True) if (use_qec and dist_m4ri._HAS_QEC_CERT)

4837 assert dist_m4ri._dem_k0(med_dem_k0_text)

4840 cd_calls = []
4841 fake_cd = SimpleNamespace(
4842 codeDistance=lambda H, G, **kw: (cd_calls.append("code"), {"d": 5, "numIter": 12})[1],
4843 circuitDistance=lambda c, **kw: (cd_calls.append("circ"), {"d": 5, "numIter": 12})[1],
4844 StimDEM2HL=lambda d: (np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1]], dtype=np.int8), np.array([[1, 1]], dtype=np.int8), [0.1, 0.1]),
4845 )

4847 capsys.readouterr()
4848 assert dist_m4ri.compute_classical_distance(h_full, solver="codedistance", return_info=True) == (0, [0, 0, 0])
4849 assert dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(eye70[:35], G=eye70[35:], solver="codedistance") == 0
4850 assert dist_m4ri.compute_css_distance(eye70[:35], eye70[35:], solver="codedistance") == (0, [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0])
4851 med_k0_file = tmp_path / "med_k0.dem"
4852 med_k0_file.write_text(med_dem_k0_text)
4853 assert dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(str(med_k0_file), solver="codedistance") == (0, [0, 0, 0])

4855 if dist_m4ri._HAS_STIM:

4857 med_ok_file.write_text(med_dem_text)

4862def test_cli_study_options_disabled(capsys, tmp_path):

4899def test_dem_rounds_single_round(capsys):
4900 # The row slabs of rw_opt 4 in the automatic rw_opt of the binary for a single-round DEM: the rounds of a Stim
4901 # circuit, circuit_measurement_rounds() (the largest number of measurements of one qubit: 1 for rounds=1 of a stim
4902 # memory circuit or rounds=0 of a circuit with one round before its REPEAT block, 3 for 3 rounds) and
4903 # circuit_single_round(), the hand-over dem_rounds=T of compute_dem_distance() for every circuit (None: automatic;
4904 # 0, 1, and 2: given), shown by the run plan of the binary (rw_opt=0x15 with the slabs, 0x11 without),
4905 # run_dist_m4ri(dem_rounds=...) (only with fdem), the CLI option dem_rounds=N, and invalid values
4906 stim = pytest.importorskip("stim")
4907 c1 = stim.Circuit.generated("surface_code:rotated_memory_x", distance=3, rounds=1,
4908 after_clifford_depolarization=0.001)
4909 c3 = stim.Circuit.generated("surface_code:rotated_memory_x", distance=3, rounds=3,
4910 after_clifford_depolarization=0.001)
4911 assert dist_m4ri.circuit_single_round(c1) and not dist_m4ri.circuit_single_round(c3)
4912 assert [dist_m4ri.circuit_measurement_rounds(c) for c in (c1, c3)] == [1, 3]
4913 assert dist_m4ri.circuit_single_round(dist_m4ri.set_circuit_rounds(c3, 0)) # (the round before the block)
4914 bb72 = os.path.join(EXAMPLES_DIR, "..", "benchmark", "stim_bb", "bb_72_12_6_si1000_r6_X.stim")
4915 assert not dist_m4ri.circuit_single_round(bb72)
4916 assert dist_m4ri.circuit_single_round(dist_m4ri.set_circuit_rounds(bb72, 0))
4917 assert not dist_m4ri.circuit_single_round(dist_m4ri.set_circuit_rounds(bb72, 1)) # (two rounds)
4918 assert dist_m4ri.circuit_measurement_rounds(bb72) == 6
4919 assert dist_m4ri.circuit_measurement_rounds(dist_m4ri.set_circuit_rounds(bb72, 1)) == 2
4920 assert not dist_m4ri.circuit_single_round(stim.Circuit("H 0\n")) # (no measurement)
4921 assert dist_m4ri.circuit_single_round(stim.Circuit("MPP X0*X1\nMPAD 0\nM 2\n")) # (MPAD: not a qubit)
4922 assert not dist_m4ri.circuit_single_round(stim.Circuit("MPP X0*X1\nM 1\n"))
4923 assert not dist_m4ri.circuit_single_round(stim.Circuit("REPEAT 2 {\n M 0\n}\n"))
4924 assert dist_m4ri.circuit_measurement_rounds(stim.Circuit("M 0\nREPEAT 3 {\n REPEAT 2 {\n M 0\n }\n}\n"
4925 "MPP X0*Z1\n")) == 8
4926 assert dist_m4ri.circuit_measurement_rounds(stim.Circuit("H 0\n")) == 0
4927 dist_m4ri.disable_distance_cache()
4928 plan = {}
4929 for name, circ, dr, passed in (("c1", c1, None, 1), ("c3", c3, None, 3), ("c1_0", c1, 0, 0),
4930 ("c3_1", c3, 1, 1), ("c3_2", c3, 2, 2)):
4931 dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(circuit=circ, method=1, num_steps=20, threads=2, dem_rounds=dr, cache_file=None,
4932 debug=dist_m4ri.PY_DBG_COMMANDS | 2)
4933 out = capsys.readouterr().out
4934 run_line = [ln for ln in out.splitlines() if "[dist_m4ri] Running:" in ln][0]
4935 assert (f"dem_rounds={passed}" in run_line) == (passed > 0) and ("dem_rounds=" in run_line) == (passed > 0)
4936 plan[name] = [ln for ln in out.splitlines() if ln.startswith("# run plan:")][0]
4937 for name in ("c1", "c3_1"):
4938 assert "rw_opt=0x15 (row slabs: dem_rounds=1)" in plan[name], plan[name]
4939 for name in ("c3", "c3_2"):
4940 assert "rw_opt=0x11," in plan[name], plan[name]
4941 with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid dem_rounds=-1"):
4942 dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(circuit=c1, method=1, num_steps=20, dem_rounds=-1, cache_file=None)
4943 dem_file = os.path.join(EXAMPLES_DIR, "surf_d3.dem") # (a DEM with round structure: no automatic slabs)
4944 for dr, part in ((0, "rw_opt=0x11,"), (1, "rw_opt=0x15 (row slabs: dem_rounds=1)")):
4945 dist_m4ri.run_dist_m4ri(method=1, fdem=dem_file, steps=20, threads=2, dem_rounds=dr,
4946 debug=dist_m4ri.PY_DBG_COMMANDS | 2)
4947 out = capsys.readouterr().out
4948 assert part in out and (f"dem_rounds={dr}" in out) == (dr > 0)
4949 with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid dem_rounds=True"):
4950 dist_m4ri.run_dist_m4ri(method=1, fdem=dem_file, steps=20, dem_rounds=True)
4951 dist_m4ri.run_dist_m4ri(method=1, finH=S5_H, finL=S5_L, steps=20, threads=2, dem_rounds=1,
4952 debug=dist_m4ri.PY_DBG_COMMANDS) # (not passed without fdem: the binary needs it)
4953 assert "dem_rounds=" not in capsys.readouterr().out
4954 assert dist_m4ri.parse_cli_args(["dem_rounds=1"])["dem_rounds"] == 1
4955 assert dist_m4ri.parse_cli_args([])["dem_rounds"] is None
4956 assert dist_m4ri.main([f"fdem={dem_file}", "method=1", "steps=20", "threads=2", "dem_rounds=1", "--no-cache",
4957 f"debug={dist_m4ri.PY_DBG_COMMANDS}"]) == 0
4958 assert "dem_rounds=1" in capsys.readouterr().out
4959 assert dist_m4ri.main([f"finH={S5_H}", f"finL={S5_L}", "method=1", "steps=20", "threads=2", "dem_rounds=1",
4960 "--no-cache"]) == 0
4961 assert "dem_rounds=: only used with fdem= (a DEM or Stim circuit); ignored" in capsys.readouterr().err
4962 assert dist_m4ri.main([f"fdem={dem_file}", "dem_rounds=-1", "--no-cache"]) == 1
4963 assert "invalid 'dem_rounds=-1'" in capsys.readouterr().err
4964 assert dist_m4ri.main(["--morehelp", "dem_rounds"]) == 0
4965 assert " dem_rounds=N The rounds T of the DEM" in capsys.readouterr().out

4968def test_explain_slab_and_window_hits(capsys):
4969 # The hits of the row slabs (and of the hybrid index windows) are counted apart and not in <n> with a nonzero
4970 # resolved rw_opt: the new lines of the binary are parsed ('row slabs' in '# RW step types', 'N window and slab hits
4971 # not counted', the note of an inactive min_hits stop), and explain_bounds() says so; an older binary without the
4972 # row slabs is still parsed
4973 err = ("# codewords accumulated: total=47, min_w=51: cws=2, total_hits=20, hits min=8, max=12, avg=10.00, "
4974 "stdev=2.00, <n>=0.00 over 45 cws of w=51..70 (min_hits=5, cov_cws=100), 20 window and slab hits not "
4975 "counted\n"
4976 "# Note: the min_hits stop was inactive: no codeword of the minimum weight 51 was found in a uniform RW "
4977 "step (<n> does not count the 20 hits of the window and slab steps)\n"
4978 "# RW information sets: n=152, rank(H)=100, steps=40 (uniform permutations: 20), ksub=0, pairs=3, "
4979 "1e-05 s/step per thread, 2 RW threads\n"
4980 "# RW step types, w=51: uniform steps: cws=0, hits=0; window steps: cws=0, hits=0; row slabs: cws=2, "
4981 "hits=20; both: cws=0 (of 2 cws)\n")
4982 st = dist_m4ri._parse_stderr_stats(err)
4983 assert st["hits_not_counted"] == 20 and st["avg_hits"] == 0.0 and st["set_cws"] == 45
4984 assert st["rw_step_types"][51] == {"uniform_cws": 0, "uniform_hits": 0, "window_cws": 0, "window_hits": 0,
4985 "slab_cws": 2, "slab_hits": 20, "both_cws": 0, "cws": 2}
4986 assert st["min_hits_inactive"].startswith("the min_hits stop was inactive")
4987 txt = dist_m4ri.explain_bounds([1, 51, 40], method=1, stats=st)
4988 assert ("Hit convergence (min_hits = 5, cov_cws = 100): inactive, no codeword of the minimum weight was found in "
4989 "a uniform RW step (the min_hits stop could not end RW); the 20 hits of the row slabs and of the window "
4990 "steps are counted apart, not in <n> (not converged).") in txt
4991 assert "0 found in the 20 uniform steps (0 hits), 2 in the 20 row-slab steps (20 hits), 0 in both" in txt
4992 # the canonical classes decide (rw_opt 16): the hits not counted are named too; the row slabs of a run (bit 4 in
4993 # the resolved mask) also for a weight which they did not reach
4994 st2 = dist_m4ri._parse_stderr_stats(
4995 err.replace("not counted\n", "not counted, not used: the canonical classes decide (see '# RW canonical')\n")
4996 + "# RW step types, w=52: uniform steps: cws=3, hits=3; window steps: cws=0, hits=0; row slabs: cws=0, hits=0; "
4997 "both: cws=0 (of 3 cws)\n# RW triplets: T3=0 (0.1 ms), G_rows=0, rw_opt=0x15\n")
4998 txt2 = dist_m4ri.explain_bounds([1, 51, 40], method=1, stats=st2)
4999 assert "is not used for the stop; the 20 hits of the row slabs and of the window steps are counted apart" in txt2
5000 assert "3 found in the 20 uniform steps (3 hits), 0 in the 20 row-slab steps (0 hits)" in txt2
5001 old = dist_m4ri._parse_stderr_stats("# RW step types, w=3: uniform steps: cws=1, hits=2; window steps: cws=1, "
5002 "hits=1; both: cws=0 (of 2 cws)\n")
5003 assert old["rw_step_types"][3]["slab_cws"] == 0 and old["rw_step_types"][3]["window_cws"] == 1
5004 assert "hits_not_counted" not in old
5005 # a run with the row slabs (explicit 0x05: the rule of <n>): <n> is the average of the uniform-step hits
5006 dem_file = os.path.join(EXAMPLES_DIR, "surf_d3.dem")
5007 res = dist_m4ri.run_dist_m4ri(method=1, fdem=dem_file, steps=300, seed=5, threads=1, rw_opt=5, cov_cws=0,
5008 min_hits=1000000000, debug=1)
5009 capsys.readouterr()
5010 st = dist_m4ri._last_run_stats
5011 types = st["rw_step_types"][3]
5012 assert types["slab_cws"] > 0 and st["hits_not_counted"] == types["slab_hits"] > 0
5013 assert st["set_cws"] == types["uniform_cws"] and abs(st["avg_hits"] - types["uniform_hits"] /
5014 types["uniform_cws"]) < 0.006
5015 txt = dist_m4ri.explain_bounds(list(res), method=1, stats=st)
5016 assert f"the {types['slab_hits']} hits of the row slabs and of the window steps are counted apart" in txt
5017 assert "row-slab steps" in txt

5058 3, 3, 6)

5061
5062 with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="json_out"):

5097# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5098# Version 0.17.4 (A4 of the final benchmark): with a certified floor wmin > 1, every call of qec_cert passes
5099# search_opts={"force_dom": 1}, so that qec_cert keeps the stabilizer dominance of its search on (it switches it off
5100# for wmin > 1 by default): Stage B of engine='auto' (quantum codes, CSS sectors, DEMs, Stim circuits) and
5101# engine='cert' from the certified dmin of a cache record (not for classical codes, which have no stabilizers).
5102# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5103
5104def _force_dom_pipeline(monkeypatch, pkg, search_opts=True, option_names=("wmin", "force_dom")):
5105 """
5106 Installs a fake qec_cert package pkg in sys.modules (restored by monkeypatch) and returns its module pipeline,
5107 whose certify() takes the parameter search_opts (or not, as an older qec_cert), with a module search whose
5108 OPTION_NAMES are option_names (None: no module search).
5109 """
5110 import types
5111 pipeline = types.ModuleType(pkg + ".pipeline")
5112 pipeline.__package__ = pkg
5113 if search_opts:
5114 def certify(problem, *, wmin=1, wmax=40, search_opts=None, **kw):
5115 raise AssertionError("not called")
5116 else:
5117 def certify(problem, *, wmin=1, wmax=40, **kw):
5118 raise AssertionError("not called")
5119 pipeline.certify = certify

5122 if option_names is not None:
5123 search = types.ModuleType(pkg + ".search")
5124 search.OPTION_NAMES = tuple(option_names)
5125 monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, pkg + ".search", search)
5126 return pipeline

5173def test_force_dom_call_sites(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
5174 # every call site: force_dom=1 with a certified floor wmin > 1, nothing new with wmin = 1
5175 import functools
5176 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri, "_qec_cert_has_force_dom", lambda qp: True)
5177 fake = _FakeBinary(["3 5 10"])
5178 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri.subprocess, "Popen", fake.popen)
5179 calls = _fake_qec_cert(monkeypatch, certify=_cert_search_lb(), certify_dem=_cert_search_lb(),
5180 certify_circuit=_cert_search_lb())
5181 force = {"force_dom": 1}
5182 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
5183 dist_m4ri.disable_distance_cache()
5184 try:
5185 # engine='auto', quantum code: Stage A [3, 5], Stage B from wmin=3 (the dmin certified by CC)
5186 d, info = dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, engine="auto", timeout=20, threads=2,
5187 return_info=True)
5188 assert (d, info) == (5, [5, 5, 0]) and len(calls) == 1 and calls[0][0] == "certify"
5189 assert calls[0][1]["wmin"] == 3 and calls[0][1]["search_opts"] == force
5190 # Stage A without a lower bound: Stage B from wmin=1 gets no search_opts (the default of qec_cert)
5191 fake.outputs, fake.cmds[:], calls[:] = ["0 5 10"], [], []
5192 dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, engine="auto", timeout=20, threads=2)
5193 assert len(calls) == 1 and calls[0][1]["wmin"] == 1 and "search_opts" not in calls[0][1]
5194 # engine='auto', CSS code: Stage B only for the sector X, open after Stage A ([3, 6])
5195 fake.outputs, fake.cmds[:], calls[:] = ["4 4 0", "3 6 50"], [], []
5196 dist_m4ri.compute_css_distance(S5_H, S5_H, Lx=S5_L, Lz=S5_L, engine="auto", timeout=20, threads=2)
5197 assert len(calls) == 1 and calls[0][1]["wmin"] == 3 and calls[0][1]["search_opts"] == force
5198 # engine='auto', DEM (certify_dem()) and Stim circuit (certify_circuit())
5199 fake.outputs, fake.cmds[:], calls[:] = ["2 5 10"], [], []
5200 dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(SURF_D3_DEM, engine="auto", timeout=20, threads=2)
5201 assert [c[0] for c in calls] == ["certify_dem"] and calls[0][1]["wmin"] == 2
5202 assert calls[0][1]["search_opts"] == force
5203 if dist_m4ri._HAS_STIM:
5204 import stim
5205 circ = stim.Circuit.generated("repetition_code:memory", distance=5, rounds=2,
5206 after_clifford_depolarization=0.001)
5207 fake.outputs, fake.cmds[:], calls[:] = ["2 5 10"], [], []
5208 dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(circuit=circ, engine="auto", timeout=20, threads=2)
5209 assert [c[0] for c in calls] == ["certify_circuit"] and calls[0][1]["search_opts"] == force
5210 # engine='cert' without a cache record: from wmin=1, no search_opts
5211 calls[:] = []
5212 dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, engine="cert")
5213 dist_m4ri.compute_classical_distance(HAMMING_H, engine="cert")
5214 dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(SURF_D3_DEM, engine="cert")
5215 assert [c[0] for c in calls] == ["certify", "certify", "certify_dem"]
5216 assert all(c[1]["wmin"] == 1 and "search_opts" not in c[1] for c in calls)
5217 finally:
5218 dist_m4ri.enable_distance_cache()
5219 # engine='cert' from the certified dmin of a cache record written by the binary (a new cache for each case): a
5220 # quantum code, the two sectors of a CSS code, and a DEM (also with pmin > 0, and on the DEM fast path of
5221 # engine='auto'), but not a classical code (no stabilizer dominance) nor method=1 (mode 'ub': no search)
5222 def fast_path(**kw): # (more than 25,000 raw error mechanisms: qec_cert first, from the floor of the cache)
5223 monkeypatch.setattr(dist_m4ri, "_dem_num_raw_errors", lambda dem, limit=0: 30000)
5224 return dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(SURF_D3_DEM, engine="auto", timeout=10, **kw)
5225
5226 def quantum(**kw):
5227 return dist_m4ri.compute_quantum_distance(S5_H, L=S5_L, **kw)
5228
5229 def css(**kw):
5230 return dist_m4ri.compute_css_distance(QX40, QZ40, **kw)
5231
5232 def classical(**kw):
5233 return dist_m4ri.compute_classical_distance(HAMMING_H, **kw)
5234
5235 def dem(**kw):
5236 return dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(SURF_D3_DEM, **kw)
5237
5238 def dem_pmin(**kw):
5239 return dist_m4ri.compute_dem_distance(SURF_D3_DEM, pmin=0.0005, **kw)
5240
5241 cases = [ # (name, the record of the binary, the call writing it, the call of qec_cert, its kinds, wmin, options)
5242 ("quantum", "3 5 10", quantum, functools.partial(quantum, engine="cert"), ["certify"], 3, force),
5243 ("quantum_ub", "3 5 10", quantum, functools.partial(quantum, engine="cert", method=1), ["certify"], 3, None),
5244 ("css", "3 5 10", css, functools.partial(css, engine="cert"), ["certify"] * 2, 3, force),
5245 ("classical", "2 3 10", classical, functools.partial(classical, engine="cert"), ["certify"], 2, None),
5246 ("dem", "2 3 10", dem, functools.partial(dem, engine="cert"), ["certify_dem"], 2, force),
5247 ]
5248 if dist_m4ri._HAS_STIM: # (the cutoff of pmin for qec_cert, see _dem_pmin_cut())
5249 cases.append(("dem_pmin", "2 3 10", dem_pmin, functools.partial(dem_pmin, engine="cert"), ["certify_dem"], 2,
5250 force))
5251 cases.append(("dem_fast_path", "2 3 10", dem, fast_path, ["certify_dem"], 2, force))
5252 try:
5253 for name, record, write, cert, kinds, w_lo, opts in cases:
5254 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()
5255 cache_file = str(tmp_path / f"a4_{name}.json")
5256 fake.outputs, fake.cmds[:] = [record], []
5257 write(threads=2, cache_file=cache_file) # (the binary: the record [w_lo, ...])
5258 calls[:] = []
5259 cert(cache_file=cache_file)
5260 assert [c[0] for c in calls] == kinds, name
5261 assert all(c[1]["wmin"] == w_lo and c[1].get("search_opts") == opts for c in calls), name
5262 finally:
5263 dist_m4ri.clear_distance_cache()

5322def _dem_floor_cert(lb, stages, reductions, wmin=6, ub=None):
5323 """A certificate (a dict) of certify_dem() from the floor wmin > 1, conditional on lb_assumed_wmin = wmin."""
5324 return {"status": "bounds", "lower_bound": lb, "upper_bound": ub, "witness_verified": True if ub else None,
5325 "instance": {"lb_conditional": True, "lb_assumed_wmin": wmin}, "stages": stages,
5326 "reductions": reductions}

5329def test_cert_wmin_discharged_dem_relaxations():
5330 # M1 of the verification of A4 (scratch/fixes_a3a4/a4/verify/VERIFY.md): certify_dem() searches the relaxations of
5331 # a DEM (the P_1 projection, spacetime folding), whose distance may be below the floor wmin of the DEM, from that
5332 # floor; a conditional lower bound of them above the floor is accepted only with the exact zero-solve sandwich
5333 # (d(P_1) = d(DEM)), and one of folding never
5334 def stage(name, lb):
5335 return {"name": name, "status": "bounds", "lb": lb, "lb_conditional": True}
5336
5337 def search(w_lo, lb): # (a search stage and its reduction, without symmetry, from the floor w_lo)
5338 flags = {"lb_conditional": True, "sym_kind": "unknown", "sym_verified": 0, "rules": list(_NOSYM_RULES)}
5339 return ({"name": "search", "status": "none", "lb": lb, **flags},
5340 {"name": "cc_mitm_search", "params": {"wmin": w_lo, "wmax": lb - 1, **flags}})
5341
5342 inexact, exact = ({"name": "zero_solve_sandwich", "status": s} for s in ("inexact", "exact"))
5343 p1_red = {"name": "p1_projection_lb", "params": {"lb": 19, "lb_conditional": True}}
5344 s19, r19 = search(6, 19)
5345 # the leak (verify/check_p1_wmin.py): the inexact P_1 projection, searched from 6, raises the bound to 19 > wmax,
5346 # so that the DEM itself is not searched (the true distance was 15)
5347 leak = _dem_floor_cert(19, [inexact, stage("p1_projection_lb", 19)], [p1_red, r19])
5348 assert not dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(leak, 6) and dist_m4ri._cert_extract_bounds(leak, 6) == (0, 0)
5349 leak_ub = dict(leak, lower_bound=17, upper_bound=17, witness_verified=True) # (qec_cert clamps it to a witness)
5350 assert dist_m4ri._cert_extract_bounds(leak_ub, 6) == (0, 17)
5351 # (the stage alone suffices, also without the reduction p1_projection_lb, e.g., from another qec_cert version)
5352 assert not dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(dict(leak, reductions=[r19]), 6)
5353 # the exact zero-solve sandwich (its P_1 searched from the floor of the DEM): valid
5354 exact_p1 = _dem_floor_cert(19, [exact, s19], [p1_red, r19])
5355 assert dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(exact_p1, 6) and dist_m4ri._cert_extract_bounds(exact_p1, 6) == (19, 0)
5356 # an inexact P_1 projection which does not raise the bound, then the DEM searched from the floor: valid
5357 s15, r15 = search(6, 15)
5358 p1_low = _dem_floor_cert(15, [inexact, stage("p1_projection_lb", 4), s15], [r15], ub=15)
5359 assert dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(p1_low, 6) and dist_m4ri._cert_extract_bounds(p1_low, 6) == (15, 15)
5360 # folding: valid only if it does not raise the bound
5361 fold_red = {"name": "capped_spacetime_folding", "params": {"period": 2, "lb": 12, "lb_conditional": True}}
5362 s10, r10 = search(6, 10)
5363 assert not dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(_dem_floor_cert(12, [stage("fold_mod_2", 12)], [fold_red, r19]), 6)
5364 assert not dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(_dem_floor_cert(12, [stage("fold_mod_2", 12)], [r19]), 6)
5365 assert not dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(_dem_floor_cert(12, [], [fold_red]), 6)
5366 assert dist_m4ri._cert_wmin_discharged(_dem_floor_cert(10, [stage("fold_mod_2", 5), s10], [r10]), 6)
5367 # end to end, from the floor 6: the bound 19 of the leak is not used
5368 dist_m4ri.disable_distance_cache()
5369 try:
5370 res = dist_m4ri._cert_code_distance(lambda: "unused", lambda w_lo, w_hi: leak, dmin=6, certified_dmin=6)
5371 assert res["d_info"] == [6, 0, 0]
5372 finally:
5373 dist_m4ri.enable_distance_cache()
5374

5376def _simplex_p1_dem():
5377 """
5378 The text of a DEM (9 detector chains, 8 rounds) whose time-collapsed projection P_1 is the [7, 3, 4] simplex code
5379 (each logical of P_1 has weight 4), with the distance 15 and an inexact zero-solve sandwich (from
5380 scratch/fixes_a3a4/a4/verify/check_p1_wmin.py of the verification of A4).
5381 """
5382 n_chains, n_rounds = 9, 8
5383 lines = [f"detector(0, {c}, {t}) D{n_rounds * c + t}" for c in range(n_chains) for t in range(n_rounds)]
5384 lines += [f"error(0.001) D{n_rounds * c + t} D{n_rounds * c + t + 1}"
5385 for c in range(n_chains) for t in range(n_rounds - 1)]
5386 cols = [[0, 1, 3], [0, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3], [0], [1], [2], [3]] # (the columns of P_1: its 4 x 7 check matrix)
5387 for j, (chains, t) in enumerate(zip(cols, [0, 2, 4, 6, 7, 5, 3])):
5388 lines.append("error(0.001) " + " ".join(f"D{n_rounds * c + t}" for c in chains) + (" L0" if j == 0 else ""))
5389 for i in range(5): # (more columns on the chains 4..8, without L0)
5390 lines.append("error(0.001) " + " ".join(f"D{n_rounds * (4 + (i + k) % 5) + i}" for k in range(3)))
5391 return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
5392

5395 # M1 with the real qec_cert (skipped unless it is usable, with stim): the floor wmin=6 of the DEM (distance 15) is
5396 # not one of P_1 (distance 4); without the rank DP (cut_rank_threshold=-1), certify_dem() raises the bound to 19
5397 # from P_1 alone, which must not be accepted; from the floor 4, and from 6 with the defaults (the DP gives d(P_1)
5398 # = 4, and the DEM is searched from 6), the discharge still certifies 15

5413 assert bounds[0] <= 15, (wmin, extra, cert.lower_bound, bounds) # (never above the distance)
